name: Roof squeeze: jump spam carries the short hitbox through a 70-tall tunnel
techNote: A floor and a roof block (x 300-700) whose bottom is 70 above the floor. Standing, the hitbox is 72 tall (offset y 2: y-34 to y+38), so the dot walks into the roof's face and stops (x 274.5). A jump sets the 54-tall air hitbox (dashColliderSize, y-27 to y+27) and moves the dot up 5 (y 39: top 66, under the roof), so pressing jump against the face slips the dot under the roof; inside, each landing grows the hitbox back to 72 and the next press shrinks it again, and the dot runs the tunnel at the full 9.2 u a tick, bonking the roof on every jump (OnCollisionStay2D's ceiling normal zeroes Velocity.y). A roof 67-71.9 above the floor squeezes this way; 66 or lower stops the jump's hitbox too.
